## Context / Problem
`tests/unit/test_ci_workflow_parity.py` (2,046 LOC, 40 top-level test functions on origin/main 62d775a5b11: the 37 counted at 083620b0 plus 3 bug-anchored KEEP tests added since — `test_sweep_extra_parity_would_have_caught_c57057f41`, `test_sweep_install_extra_drift_is_declared_and_actionable` (trustful-combative-grackle, Gerrit 2842) and `test_module_size_gate_retries_trusted_main_fetch_before_failing_closed`) was written to grep two hand-copied gate lists; its own docstring records that the lists are now ONE reusable workflow, so 11 of its tests re-assert `.github/workflows/*.yml` config snapshots and duplicate `scripts/check_verify_gate_parity.py` (184 LOC) and `tests/unit/test_gerrit_docs_only.py:31-53`. `tests/unit/test_verify_gate_parity.py::test_real_repo_verify_gate_is_in_parity` (`:115`) re-runs that script in-process while the script runs only as a CI step (`_build-and-test.yml:145-152`), not from `make lint`. The per-test verdicts (table (4)) are itemised in this ticket's first comment. Line cites are from 083620b0 and have drifted; test and helper NAMES are authoritative (all 13 named tests and all 8 named helpers still exist on 62d775a5b11).

## Approach
Per table (4):
- Delete tests 2 `test_matrix_keeps_every_test_tier_but_collects_coverage_once`, 3 `test_diff_coverage_step…`, 4 `test_scanner_gate_uses_one_reusable…`, 5 `test_mutation_gate_uses_one_reusable…`, 6 `test_mutation_workflows_are_bounded_and_publish_results`, 9 `test_mutation_reusable_expands_selector_json…` (`:463-766`), 10 `test_shared_gate_signatures_live_in_the_reusable`, 11 `test_documentation_gate_signatures_live_in_the_shared_action`, 20 `test_repo_policy_nodes_partition_the_default_selection_exactly` (`:1208`; it hard-codes node ids that S3 and S4 delete, which is why this story lands before them), 35 `test_makefile_lint_runs_both_config_gates`, 36 `test_ci_runs_the_config_gates_through_make_lint_not_a_duplicate_step` (wiring moves to the S3 census).
- Rewrite 19 `test_optionality_contract_gates_the_verified_path` (`:1086`) to parametrize over every `uses: ./.github/workflows/_*.yml` job in `gerrit-verify.yaml` (6 jobs, `:220-308`), asserting `with.gerrit-refspec == "${{ inputs.GERRIT_REFSPEC }}"` and that a push/PR lane `uses` the same reusable; this subsumes 4 and 5.
- Keep 21 `test_repo_policy_nodes_run_only_in_the_existing_primary_cell` (`:1221`) minus the job-set snapshot at `:1231`; keep every other test the table marks KEEP.
- Remove the helpers and constants left unused: `_SHARED_GATE_SIGNATURES`, `_DOCUMENTATION_GATE_SIGNATURES`, `_COVERAGE_FLAGS`, `_expanded_test_matrix`, `_coverage_flags_by_cell`, `_REPO_POLICY_MODULES`, `_REPO_POLICY_NODE_IDS`.
- Net for the module: 40 → 29 top-level functions (28 kept unchanged in name + the rewritten 19); the 11 named deletions are the whole delete set.
- Survivor between `tests/unit/test_verify_gate_parity.py` and the script: the script. Delete the two real-tree re-runs `test_real_repo_verify_gate_is_in_parity` and `test_real_repo_check_main_returns_zero` (the second was added after 083620b0); keep the 7 synthetic tests, which hold the RED half of the script's contract. Add `python scripts/check_verify_gate_parity.py` after `Makefile:439` with a two-line `@#` comment naming this story. The CI step stays; the ~50 ms double run is accepted because workflow files are out of this epic's scope. The script's remaining assertion (`scripts/check_verify_gate_parity.py:143-165`): `vote.needs` ⊇ every job of `test.yml`/`optionality.yml`/`verify-identity.yml`/`prompt-eval.yml` minus `EXCLUDED_JOBS`, plus `classify`/`docs-only`.
- `_OPTIONALITY_SUITE_ITEM_COUNT` (`:1132`) stays at 10 in this story; S4 sets it to 9 when it deletes one `test_core_optionality.py` test.

## Scope
In scope: `tests/unit/test_ci_workflow_parity.py`, `tests/unit/test_verify_gate_parity.py`, `Makefile`. Out of scope: every file under `.github/workflows/`, `scripts/check_verify_gate_parity.py` itself, `tests/unit/test_gerrit_docs_only.py`, and the check-script twins (S3).

## Testing
`pytest --collect-only -q tests/unit/test_ci_workflow_parity.py tests/unit/test_verify_gate_parity.py` before and after: exactly 13 fewer top-level test functions (11 + 2) plus the delta from parametrizing 19 over the 6 jobs; both collect counts are recorded on this ticket. `make lint` runs the parity script and prints `Verified-gate parity: OK`; `make test` green.

## Acceptance Criteria
- [x] The 28 kept functions plus the rewritten 19 collect from `tests/unit/test_ci_workflow_parity.py`; each of the 11 deleted names collects nothing (`pytest --collect-only -q tests/unit/test_ci_workflow_parity.py -k <name>` per name).
- [x] `make lint` invokes `scripts/check_verify_gate_parity.py` (verified by `make -n lint | grep check_verify_gate_parity`).
- [x] The RED half of the script's contract still holds on synthetic input via the 7 kept tests in `tests/unit/test_verify_gate_parity.py` (`pytest tests/unit/test_verify_gate_parity.py` green, 7 nodes).
- [x] `_SHARED_GATE_SIGNATURES`, `_DOCUMENTATION_GATE_SIGNATURES`, `_COVERAGE_FLAGS`, `_expanded_test_matrix`, `_coverage_flags_by_cell`, `_REPO_POLICY_MODULES`, `_REPO_POLICY_NODE_IDS` are gone (`git grep -n` on each name under `tests/` prints nothing).
- [x] `make verify` green apart from the 17 arm64-host pandoc failures tracked in frenzied-snively-llama.
